title: Very Beautiful and a Liar
overview: The film stars Dalida Khalil and Ziad Bourji, and was released in Lebanon in 2013. It was made as a sequel to the original series which follows Dalida, a young woman known for constantly lying. She falls deeply in love with famous singer Ramzi Dib.
